nodes.name: Carbon cloth pretreatment
nodes.procedure: Carbon cloth (1 × 2 cm²) was soaked in concentrated sulfuric acid (H2SO4, 98%) over the night. Then the carbon cloth was ultrasonicated for 15 min in ethanol solution. Finally, the carbon cloth was washed by deionized water several times.
nodes.source_text: 4.2. Pretreatment of carbon cloth... Carbon cloth (1 × 2 cm²) was soaked in concentrated sulfuric acid (H2SO4, 98%) over the night. Then the carbon cloth was ultrasonicated for 15 min in ethanol solution. Finally, the carbon cloth was washed by deionized water several times.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of Co(OH)2
nodes.procedure: 5 mmol Co(NO3)2·6H2O was dissolved in 10 mL ethanol and 40 mL deionized water to form a clear solution. The pretreated carbon cloth inserted into the clear solution was used as a working electrode, graphene rod and Ag/AgCl (saturated KCl solution) were used as the counter electrode and reference electrode, respectively. Chronoamperometry procedure was conducted at -1.0 V for 20 min to obtain green surface Co(OH)2 nanosheets precursor.
nodes.source_text: 4.3. Synthesis of Co(OH)2 nanosheets precursor on carbon cloth... 5 mmol Co(NO3)2·6H2O was dissolved in 10 mL ethanol and 40 mL deionized water... Chronoamperometry procedure was conducted at -1.0 V for 20 min.

nodes.name: Plasma-assisted CVD of CoNPs@C
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared Co(OH)2 nanosheets precursor converted into CoNPs@C sheet-like structures by microwave plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition system (MPECVD). The rectangular microwave waveguide couples the microwave power in a quartz tube, which generated the plasma. And the as-prepared Co(OH)2 precursor was placed in the reaction chamber. The MPECVD system was evacuated to 2 mTorr, then the CH4 gas flowed into the reaction chamber at a flow rate of 20 sccm. CH4 plasma were generated at 700 W for 10 min with a base pressure of 25 Torr.

nodes.name: Annealing for bare CoNPs
nodes.procedure: The carbon cloth with Co(OH)2 nanosheets precursor was annealed at 300°C for 90 min under a gas flow of 100 sccm Ar and 100 sccm H2, with a pressure of 0.01 MPa. After the reaction, we obtained bare CoNPs sheet-like structures.

nodes.characterization_summary: Initial CoNPs@C shows sheet-like structures with rough surface uniformly grown on carbon cloth. ECA-CoNPs@C preserves sheet-like morphology after activation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The initial CoNPs@C sheet-like structures with rough surface uniformly grow on carbon cloth and they are interconnected with each other (Fig. 1a and inset of Fig. 1a). As shown in Fig. 1b and inset of Fig. 1b, the original sheet-like morphology is still preserved after electrochemical activation.

nodes.characterization_summary: BET surface area of CoNPs@C is 34.28 m²/g and ECA-CoNPs@C is 30.07 m²/g, both significantly higher than Co(OH)₂ precursor at 5.804 m²/g.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The BET specific surface area of the carbon cloth is calculated to be 0.33 m² g⁻¹ ... The BET surface area of nitrogen for the CoNPs@C (34.28 m² g⁻¹) ... And the BET specific surface area of ECA-CoNPs@C (30.07 m² g⁻¹).

nodes.characterization_summary: Initial CoNPs@C sheet-like structures consist of graphene-encapsulated Co nanoparticles confirmed by TEM.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The transmission electron microscopy (TEM) image reveals that the initial CoNPs@C sheet-like structures consist of graphene-encapsulated Co nanoparticles (Fig. S3).

nodes.characterization_summary: ECA-CoNPs@C shows 2.03 Å (111) planes of metal Co and Co(OH)₂ with 2.36 Å (011) and 2.74 Å (100) planes. Co/C/Co(OH)₂ three-tier structure confirmed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 1d shows the HR-TEM image of ECA-CoNPs@C the well-resolved lattice fringes with interplanar distances of 2.03 Å is indexed to (111) planes of metal Co ... The crystalline lattice fringe of the external irregular NPs with adjacent-plane of 2.36 Å corresponds to Co(OH)₂ ... The inter-planar distances of 2.74 Å and 2.36 Å correspond to the (100) and (011) planes of Co(OH)₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoNPs@C shows hcp (PDF #05-0727) and fcc (PDF #15-0806) metallic Co phases. ECA-CoNPs@C retains same peaks with slightly declined intensity indicating partial Co oxidation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 2a, the diffraction peaks for CoNPs@C correspond well to the metallic Co. There are two phases of hcp (PDF #05-0727) and fcc (PDF #15-0806) of Co ... The ECA-CoNPs@C shows the same diffraction peaks as the initial CoNPs@C, but the intensity of the diffraction peaks slightly decline.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co 2p XPS of CoNPs@C shows metallic Co peaks at 778.5 eV (2p3/2) and 793.6 eV (2p1/2). ECA-CoNPs@C retains metallic Co but shows intensive Co(OH)₂ peaks at 781.2 eV and 785.7 eV plus increased O 1s signal.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Co 2p spectra for initial CoNPs@C exhibits two sharp metallic Co 2p3/2 and Co 2p1/2 peak, appearing at 778.5 eV and 793.6 eV, respectively ... As for XPS spectrum of ECA-CoNPs@C, the peak for metallic Co is well retained but the intensity of Co peak slightly decline, and two intensive peaks appeared at 781.2 eV and 785.7 eV are corresponding to Co(OH)₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance Cdl of ECA-CoNPs@C is 100 mF cm⁻² compared to 40 mF cm⁻² for CoNPs@C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the Cdl was only 40 mF cm⁻² for CoNPs@C (Fig. 2f), indicating that the activated CoNPs@C sheet-like structures can afford more accessible active sites.

nodes.characterization_summary: O peak almost undetectable in initial CoNPs@C but obvious in ECA-CoNPs@C, confirming increased oxygen content after activation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the EDS spectrum of the initial sample, the O peak is almost undetectable (Fig. S23). In contrast, the EDS spectrum of activated sample shows an obvious peak at O position (Fig. S8).

nodes.characterization_summary: Mass loading of CoNPs@C nanosheet estimated at 3.43 mg cm⁻².
nodes.evidence_snippet: The mass loading of CoNPs@C nanosheet was estimated at about 3.43 mg cm⁻². (see the caption of Fig. S23).
